source.title: The Lost Craftsman
source.description: <Crafter Wilhem seems unable to assist you but he suggested that his former master, a man called Omarion, could. Should you find him, he might know more about this material.>
source.completion: I see how it is. No one comes looking for me unless they need something. It's fine, it's fine. I don't need rescuing anyway. I'm content to just die here in this light-forsaken place. Please, just leave me to it.
